svg.text: THE SEED DODECAGON C₁₂ TREE-MANDALA: BIRTH OF ALL 3,580 ORBITS FROM THE 3 SEEDS
Upper Hemisphere: Symmetric & Polygonal Branches (913/913 Decomposable + Seed Orbits 100% CERTIFIED UNSAT) | Lower Hemisphere: The 1,632-Orbit Asymmetric Freckle Canopy (|Stab| = 1)
Co-Pinch Span k = 1: C₁₂ → C₂ ⊔ C₁₀
Co-Pinch Span k = 2: C₁₂ → C₈ ⊔ C₄
Co-Pinch Span k = 3: C₁₂ → C₆ ⊔ C₆
Double Span-2: C₁₂ → C₄ ⊔ C₄ ⊔ C₄
▲ SYMMETRIC CLASS-6 BRANCHES (|Stab_B₆| ≥ 2: 1,038 Orbits | Dihedral D₆ Spine |Stab|=12 at Top)
▼ ASYMMETRIC FRECKLE CANOPY (|Stab_B₆| = 1: 1,632 Irreducible Orbits across Rings h = 1..6)
Seed Dodecagon C₁₂ (h=0, 3/3 UNSAT) & D₆ Spine (|Stab|=12, 18 Orbits)
Green Nodes = Certified UNSAT Orbits | 7-Level Class-6 Ring Grading: 3 (h=0) + 18 (h=1) + 119 (h=2) + 347 (h=3) + 749 (h=4) + 853 (h=5) + 581 (h=6) = 2,670 Orbits (+ 910 Decomposable = 3,580 Total)
